name: The Executioner
source: The Executioner puts you in the shoes of a man who tortures people for a living while trying to retain his own sanity. It tells the story of a man who inherited his father’s trade: to torture and execute criminals in the name of the Crown and for the amusement of the bloodthirsty masses. In his spare time the Executioner attempts to clear his own conscience investigating his victims’ crimes.
